title: Duplicate Check
statement:
Decide whether any value occurs at least twice in an array.

Contract
- `numbers` is non-null and may be empty. Values may be any `int`.
- Return `true` when at least two different positions hold equal values, otherwise `false`.
- Do not mutate `numbers`.

Examples
- `hasDuplicate(new int[]{4, 9, 1, 4})` returns `true`.
- `hasDuplicate(new int[]{3, 8, 5})` returns `false`.
- `hasDuplicate(new int[0])` returns `false`.
hints: Compare every pair of positions first, and note how many comparisons that takes.
Remember each value you have already seen so a repeat can be recognised immediately.
Stop at the first repeat using a hash set. Intended complexity: expected O(n) time and O(n) extra space, where n is the array length.
inputSyntax: Input: the array values, for example: [4, 9, 1, 4]
